prompt: The video begins with the viewer moving through an expansive, dimly lit indoor space characterized by a long corridor lined with arches and intricate ceiling designs, transitioning smoothly into an outdoor setting at night. As the camera advances, it captures the gradual shift from the enclosed area to a wide, open park pathway flanked by trees and lampposts, all under a heavy rainfall. The camera continues forward along the wet pavement, reflecting the soft glow of the streetlights that intermittently illuminate the scene. The surrounding environment is shrouded in darkness, punctuated by the occasional flicker of light from the lamps, creating a moody and atmospheric ambiance. The camera maintains a steady, forward-moving angle, offering a continuous view of the path as it curves gently through the park. The rain adds a layer of texture to the visuals, with droplets visibly falling and accumulating on the ground. The scene remains devoid of people, emphasizing the solitude and quietness of the night. The camera's movement is fluid, maintaining a consistent pace as it navigates the winding road, capturing the serene yet somber beauty of East Maddon Park under the rainy night sky.
location: East Maddon Park, London, United Kingdom
